BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repealing the model traffic ordinance; creatingnew sections; repealing RCW 46.90.005 and 46.90.010; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes that district andmunicipal courts have jurisdiction to hear and determine trafficinfractions that are violations of state law. To promote highwaysafety and uniform traffic laws within this state, the legislatureencourages city, town, and county governments to cite to and use statelaw when adjudicating civil and criminal traffic violations. It is notthe legislature's intent to deny any local authority its legislativepower, but rather to enhance safe and efficient movement of trafficthroughout the state by promoting uniform traffic laws.

The following acts or parts of acts, as nowexisting or hereafter amended, are each repealed effective June 30,2012: RCW 46.90.005 (Purpose) and 1993 c 400 s 1 & 1975 1st ex.s. c54 s 1; and p. 1 SB 5851 RCW 46.90.010 (Adoption of model traffic ordinanceAmendments)and 1993 c 400 s 2 & 1975 1st ex.s. c 54 s 2.
The department of licensing shall notifylocal governments that the department's rules regarding the modeltraffic ordinance will be repealed as a result of this act.
